claim:
Let \(T=(D,E)\) be the countable random tournament and let \(M\) be Koponen’s homogeneous four-ternary-relation reduct obtained by identifying every finite tournament pattern with its global converse. Then \(\operatorname{Aut}(M)\) is exactly the group of automorphisms and anti-automorphisms of \(T\). The hidden edge relation \(E\) is not definable in \(M\) over zero or one parameter, but for every two distinct parameters \(a,b\), it is definable over \(a,b\); thus the exact parameter-definability threshold is 2. Moreover, if \(A\subseteq M\) is finite with \(m=|A|\), then for every \(n\ge1\),
\[
|S_n^M(A)|=\sum_{k=0}^n B_{m,n,k}w_{m,k},\qquad
B_{m,n,k}=\frac1{k!}\sum_{i=0}^k(-1)^i\binom{k}{i}(m+k-i)^n,
\]
where \(d_{m,k}=mk+\binom{k}{2}\) and
\[
w_{m,k}=\begin{cases}
2^{d_{m,k}},&m\ge2,\\
1,&m\le1\text{ and }d_{m,k}=0,\\
2^{d_{m,k}-1},&m\le1\text{ and }d_{m,k}>0.
\end{cases}
\]
In particular, \(|S_1^M(A)|=m+2^m\) for \(m\ge2\), while one parameter has only two complete 1-types, and the injective ordered \(r\)-tuple orbit count over the empty set is \(1\) for \(r=1\) and \(2^{\binom r2-1}\) for \(r\ge2\).
integrity: The eligible source is Koponen's 2017 preprint (Primary MSC 03C10 in the published version). The proof uses her exact preserve-or-reverse tuple equivalence and homogeneity, separates prior reduct classification from the retained contribution, and verifies the finite counting formulas by independent canonical enumeration of equality patterns and complement-orbits.
scientific_limitations: Bennett's classification and the identification of the random-tournament global-reversal reduct are prior; novelty is restricted to the two-parameter definability threshold and the explicit finite-parameter type spectrum.
The formulas cover only Koponen's global-converse reduct, not the vertex-switching or switching-plus-reversal reducts of the random tournament.
The derivation is short once the reduct is recognized, so unpublished-folklore risk remains despite targeted published-finding corpus and web searches.
title: Two parameters recover the hidden tournament in Koponen’s reversal reduct, with an exact finite-type spectrum
